nodes.label: active
nodes.note: The status a flow is defined into unless its start beat is terminal. This machine is the cursor of a multi-beat flow, so active is the initial state. A single-beat definition whose start beat is terminal lands on completed instead, and that case is out of this fixture.

nodes.label: paused
nodes.note: Pause requires active and resume requires paused. A paused cursor refuses advance.

nodes.label: completed
nodes.note: Advance sets completed when the transition has no next beat, or the next beat is terminal. Not a terminal state of this machine: restart leaves it.

nodes.label: stopped
nodes.note: Stop accepts active or paused. Not a terminal state of this machine: restart leaves it.

edges.guard: the next beat is not terminal
there is no next beat, or the next beat is terminal
